sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Round picture parts
sections.what: Provides the round holder, the picture that fills it, and the grey fallback shown while the picture is loading or missing. Users see a circle with a photo or a placeholder.
sections.why: Keeps profile pictures looking the same on every page.
sections.watch_out: The fallback is the only content visible when the picture fails, so it should show something useful such as initials.

summary: Round profile picture parts, with a fallback that appears when no picture is ready.
purpose: Shows a user's photo in a circle, or a placeholder such as initials when the photo is missing or still loading.
why: Likely reason: a shared avatar so every profile picture in the app looks the same. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Step 1: Marks the file to run in the browser. Step 2: Builds the round outer holder. Step 3: Builds the image part that fills the circle. Step 4: Builds the fallback that shows a grey circle with content. Step 5: Makes the three parts available to other files.
inputs: An image address for the picture part, and content such as initials for the fallback.
outputs: A round picture or a placeholder circle on screen.
risks: If the image fails and the fallback has no content, the user sees an empty grey circle.
debug: If no picture appears, check the image address and whether the fallback shows instead. If the circle is the wrong size, check the size classes on the holder.
